title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 11
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. 

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

0:00 - Intro
1:57 - Land Sale Recap
19:16 - Funding the Project
25:09 - Consensus
25:42 - Game Demo with Charles Hoskinson and others from IOHK
27:15 - Team Meeting + Cardano Meet-Up
30:05 - Business Meetings + Land Staking (#soon)
30:42 - Cardano Booth at Consensus
36:00 - Big Things Coming
36:21 - Custom Dome Sale
37:10 - LEAK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
